LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_ExportMarkdownTip: Write the currently displayed colony chronicle as a standalone Markdown (.md) file.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_ExportHtmlTip: Write the currently displayed colony chronicle as an offline self-contained HTML (.html) file.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_ExportFooterNote: Evidence-based single-branch colony chronicle. Recording gaps and undated traces are kept explicit without interpolating missing intervals.
LanguageData.RWS_Diag_CopyTip: Copy a read-only anonymous diagnostic summary to the clipboard. Contains zero file paths, colony/faction/world names, campaign IDs, hashes, or secrets.
LanguageData.RWS_Diag_SaveTip: Save a read-only anonymous diagnostic summary (.txt) to the exports folder. Contains zero file paths, colony/faction/world names, campaign IDs, hashes, or secrets.
LanguageData.RWS_Diag_Copied: Copied anonymous diagnostic summary (no paths, colony names, or IDs) to clipboard.
LanguageData.RWS_Diag_Saved: Saved anonymous diagnostic summary (no paths, colony names, or IDs).
